nodes.name: app.py
nodes.summary: Flask application factory that configures the database, registers all route blueprints, and creates tables on startup.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Defines the SQLAlchemy ORM data model: Users, Songs, Tags, ListeningEvents, Ratings, Playlists, Notifications.

nodes.name: seed_data.py
nodes.summary: Standalone script that resets and seeds the database with sample data.

nodes.name: playlist_service.py
nodes.summary: Playlist creation and retrieval logic. Note: get_playlist_songs returns songs[:-1], silently dropping the last song — a suspected bug.

nodes.name: streak_service.py
nodes.summary: Listening-streak logic. Note: update_listening_streak only increments on consecutive days if today.weekday() != 6 (Sunday), so a consecutive listen on Sunday resets the streak instead of incrementing — a suspected bug.

nodes.name: test_playlists.py
nodes.summary: Pytest suite for the playlist service.

nodes.name: test_streaks.py
nodes.summary: Pytest suite for the streak service, including test_streak_increments_on_sunday which targets the Sunday bug.

nodes.name: playlists.py
nodes.summary: Flask blueprint exposing playlist HTTP routes.

nodes.name: users.py
nodes.summary: Flask blueprint exposing user-related HTTP routes.

nodes.name: notification_service.py
nodes.summary: Notification creation/retrieval, adding songs to playlists, and saving song ratings. Note: rate_song does not create a notification when a song is rated, unlike add_to_playlist — a suspected bug (issue #4 in README).

nodes.name: songs.py
nodes.summary: Flask blueprint for song-related HTTP routes: search, detail, rating, listen-tracking.

nodes.name: search_service.py
nodes.summary: Song search and lookup logic. Note: search_songs does an outerjoin against song_tags without .distinct(), producing duplicate rows for multi-tag songs — a suspected bug (issue #3 in README).

nodes.name: test_search.py
nodes.summary: Pytest suite for the search service covering duplicate-prevention behavior.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview describing app structure, setup instructions, and the five open bugs to fix.

nodes.name: requirements.txt
nodes.summary: Python dependency manifest: Flask, Flask-SQLAlchemy, SQLAlchemy, python-dotenv, pytest.

nodes.name: feed.py
nodes.summary: Flask Blueprint for friends-listening-now and activity-feed HTTP endpoints.

nodes.name: feed_service.py
nodes.summary: Friends Listening Now and activity feed logic. Note: contains the open 'shows people from yesterday' bug (issue #2 in README) — the RECENT_THRESHOLD/cutoff filtering logic is suspect.
